resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Comments[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Now, that we know how to create a simple Go program and output text, let's learn about [b]comments[/b]!
Comments are statements in the code that explain what the code is doing.

In Go, you can create a single line comment using two slashes //.

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="go" codeId="3293"]// generate the output
fmt.Println("some text") [/code]
Anything that follows the slashes is considered a comment.
[note]Writing comments is a good practice and allows you and other developers to easier read and understand what the code is doing.[/note]

resolved.title: 注释 Comment
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Comments[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You can also create multi-line comments in Go!
To do this we put the comment inside /* and */.

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="go" codeId="3294"]func main() {
    /*
This is an example program
that only generates a simple
text output using the "fmt" package
*/
    fmt.Println("Hey")
} [/code]
[note]As comments are not executed as code, you can use /* */ to comment out code blocks that you do not want to execute while you are testing your program.[/note]
[s0l0!-coach id="1167" name="To Comment Or Not To Comment" xp="10" description="Comment & uncomment to result in the expected output." imageUrl="/content/assets/314faaee1777c0cdb9c9.png" button="Start" color="366D9B"]Practice what you've learned.[/s0l0!-coach]

resolved.title: 排行榜
resolved.problem_statement_md:
给你一个程序，它应该输出排名为**偶数**的排行榜。
然而，有人在代码中添加和删除注释，破坏了这一逻辑。

请添加注释和取消注释来修复错误，让程序得到期望输出。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Leaderboard[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are given a program that should output the [b]even[/b] ranks of a leaderboard.
However, somebody added and removed comments in the code, breaking that logic.
Fix the code by commenting and uncommenting the corresponding lines to generate the desired output.
[note]The resulting program should output only the [b]even[/b] ranks of the leaderboard.[/note]
